sources.title: FinGPT: Open-Source Financial Large Language Models | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: FinGPT, from the AI4Finance Foundation, is an open-source effort to build financial large language models that anyone can run and adapt. Instead of training a costly model from scratch like BloombergGPT, FinGPT takes strong open base models and fine-tunes them with the lightweight LoRA method, so a fresh model can be produced for less than $300 ...
